title.sr: Prve zabeležene borbe gladijatora u Rimu
title.en: First recorded gladiatorial combats in Rome

description.sr: 264. godine pre nove ere, na početku Prvog punskog rata, zabeležena je prva zvanična borba gladijatora u Rimu — zarobljenici puštani da se ubijaju međusobno na sahrani rimskog velikodostojnika, običaj preuzet od Etruraca.
description.en: In 264 BCE, at the start of the First Punic War, the first officially recorded gladiatorial combat in Rome took place — prisoners were allowed to kill each other at the funeral of a Roman dignitary, a custom borrowed from the Etruscans.

title.en: Opening of the Colosseum in Rome

description.sr: Koloseum, koji je počeo da gradi car Vespazijan, završen je za vreme njegovog sina Tita, krajem 70-ih ili početkom 80-ih godine; na inauguralnoj svečanosti ubijeno je oko 9.000 životinja.
description.en: The Colosseum, whose construction was begun by Emperor Vespasian, was completed during the reign of his son Titus, in the late 70s or early 80s; at the inaugural ceremony about 9,000 animals were killed.

events.quote: kada je otvoren Koloseum, odnosno kada je završen tamo negde početkom devete decenije ... Koloseum je gradio Vespazijan, a završen je za vreme njegovog sina Tita.
